# MyApp Evaluation Harness

This project evaluates the agentic chat application using the
[Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/ai/evaluation) framework.

## Evaluated Quality Metrics

| Metric | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Relevancy | Measures whether responses address the user's question |
| Coherence | Measures logical consistency and structure |
| Fluency | Measures natural language quality |

## Running Evaluations

```bash
# Set required environment variables
export CHAT_ENDPOINT="https://<your-endpoint>.openai.azure.com"
export CHAT_API_KEY="<your-key>"

# Run all evaluation scenarios
dotnet test MyApp.Evaluation
```

## Reports

After a test run, an HTML evaluation report is written to:

```
MyApp.Evaluation/bin/Debug/net10.0/evaluation-report/
```

Open `report.html` to view metric scores and conversation traces.
